head: 94c013506f5d782870868bfb0d65ff43ba74ca95
summary: The evals workflow runs on a plain `pull_request` trigger (not `pull_request_target`) scoped only by a `paths` filter on CLAUDE.md/.claude/**/evals/**, so a pull request from any fork that touches one of those paths executes that fork's own copy of this workflow file and of sdlc.yaml's commands.setup, with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN available in the job's environment - letting an attacker who opens such a PR add a step (or a setup command) that exfiltrates both secrets over the open internet, since GitHub Actions runners are not subject to the project's own Claude-sandbox network allowlist.
